bitcoin_articles.headline: Bluebird Mining Ventures Reports First Revenues and Strategic Update
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bluebird Mining Ventures Ltd announced its first-ever revenues from streaming and digital asset activities in April 2026 and entered a term sheet for a new Bitcoin mining deployment.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BitGo Partners with Moon Inc. to Power Bitcoin-Linked Consumer Card Products in Asia
bitcoin_articles.summary: BitGo Holdings, Inc. has entered a strategic partnership with Moon Inc. to provide the infrastructure layer for its bitcoin-linked consumer card products across Asia.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF Flows Reported for May 15, 2026
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock's IBIT Bitcoin ETF recorded $144 million in inflows, while its ETHA Ethereum ETF saw $13.2 million in outflows on May 15, 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Lion Group Holding Ltd. Acquires 88.49 Bitcoin for $8 Million
bitcoin_articles.summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd. (NASDAQ: LGHL) has purchased 88.49 Bitcoin for $8 million as part of a strategic initiative to incorporate digital assets into its treasury reserves.

bitcoin_articles.headline: The9 to Purchase 2000 Bitcoin Miners for Over $6 Million
bitcoin_articles.summary: The9 Limited has announced an agreement to acquire 2,000 Bitcoin mining machines for a total consideration exceeding $6 million.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Canaan Inc. Reports April 2026 Bitcoin Mining Production and Operational Updates
bitcoin_articles.summary: Canaan Inc. announced its unaudited bitcoin mining results for April 2026, reporting 90 BTC produced from self-mining operations and total holdings of 1,826 BTC and 3,952 ETH.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BitFuFu Announces April 2026 Bitcoin Production and Operational Metrics
bitcoin_articles.summary: BitFuFu reported 145 BTC in production for April 2026, citing a power outage at its Ethiopia facility and a strategic reduction in third-party hashrate procurement.
